title: Keratinos
extract:
Keratinos are Infested claws that grow in length to perform a deadly spin attack for Heavy Attacks. The claws stay in their increased range for 3 minutes when a heavy attack is executed at full combo.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Vermillion Storm,  Four Riders,  Malicious Raptor and  Scarlet Hurricane (Conclave only) stance.
It has a unique Heavy Attack:
The first attack consists of a spin with 6 hits. The first 3 hits do 100% damage, the next 3 do 100% damage and have forced  Slash procs.
The second attack is a lunge with one hit that does 500% damage and has a forced  Slash proc.
Heavy Attacking with 12x combo grants +2.8m range to all melee attacks for 180 seconds.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Third highest base damage of all claws, behind  Garuda Talons and  Garuda Prime Talons.
Second highest status chance of all claws, behind Garuda Talons and Garuda Prime Talons.

Acquisition
Keratinos are acquired by reaching Rank 0 - Neutral with the Entrati. Father sells the main blueprint for  1,000 and component blueprints for  500; a total of  3,000 is needed for all parts.

Trivia
The Keratinos' name is most likely derived from Keratin, a fibrous protein which makes up the claws, nails, hair, feathers, and hooves of most animals.
